note: The authoritative list of legal holds in effect over records under /Documents/Records. A hold recorded here suspends destruction of every record it covers, for its whole duration, regardless of the retention window and regardless of any batch sign-off. retention_review.sh evaluates only the holds transcribed into the retention register's own holds block; a hold recorded here but not yet in the register will NOT be caught by the review, so every clear-down must cross-check this registry directly (see policies/records_retention_policy.md section 2).
